title: MeshHistoryLine
description: One line of mesh/history.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): the index of one block of mesh/history.bin. The first snapshot, when the recording opens, writes every mesh anchor as add; later snapshots write anchors whose geometry changed; the final snapshot, when it closes, writes every mesh anchor with final true. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t never decreases; an anchor's first line is an add; transform, offset, bytes, vertices and faces are null exactly for remove; each block lies inside history.bin; and capture_id is set only on final lines.

transform.description: Anchor to world at t, or null for remove.

offset.description: Where the block starts in history.bin, or null for remove.

bytes.description: The block's length in history.bin (compressed), or null for remove.

vertices.description: Vertices in the block, or null for remove.

faces.description: Faces in the block, or null for remove.

final.description: true for a final snapshot, which holds every mesh anchor with the transforms read at that moment.

capture_id.description: On a final snapshot taken at a segment's session-end reads (with continuous_session), that segment's capture_id; else null.
